title: A Study to Assess the Adverse Events and Change in Disease Activity of Multiple Treatment Combinations with Telisotuzumab Adizutecan in Participants with Metastatic Colorectal Cancer
official: A Phase 2, Open-Label, Randomized, Master Protocol Study to Evaluate Safety and Efficacy of Multiple Treatment Combinations with Telisotuzumab Adizutecan in Subjects with Metastatic Colorectal Cancer (AndroMETa-CRC-533)
summary:
Main objective: 1)  To evaluate the efficacy of telisotuzumab adizutecan combinations as compared to standard of care treatment in Metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC).
2) To evaluate the safety and tolerability of telisotuzumab adizutecan combinations.
3) To optimize the telisotuzumab adizutecan dose in combination regimens to determine the recommended Phase 3 dose (RP3D) in applicable substudies.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Substudy 1 and 2: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1.
2. Substudy 1 and 2: QTc < 470 msec (using Fridericia's correction), no Grade 3 arrythmia, and no other clinically significant cardiac abnormalities.
3. Substudy 1 and 2: Participant has histologically or cytologically confirmed mCRC.
4. Substudy 1 and 2: Participant has measurable disease per RECIST v1.1.
5. Substudy 2: Left sided primary tumor
Exclusion criteria:
1. Substudy 1 and 2: Prior systemic therapy for mCRC.
2. Substudy 1 and 2: History of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, organizing pneumonia (e.g., bronchiolitis obliterans), drug-induced pneumonitis that required treatment with systemic steroids, or idiopathic pneumonitis.
3. Substudy 1 and 2: History of other malignancies within 5 years prior to screening, except for malignancies with a negligible risk of metastasis or death (e.g., 5-year OS rate > 90%).
4. Substudy 2: History of treatment with any anti-EGFR treatments (cetuximab or panitumumab).
